source_title: Indian Bank raises special term deposit rates by 15 bps from October 23 - Business Standard
source_excerpt:
Indian Bank has raised rates on its 555-day Ind Grow and 777-day Ind Prosper deposit schemes by 15 basis points each, following the RBI's October repo rate increase.
Indian Bank raised interest rates on its 555-day and 777-day special term deposit schemes by 15 basis points each, effective October 23.
